newsitem.title: CROATIA: Zagrebacka Banka says group H1 result due Sept 13.
newsitem.headline: Zagrebacka Banka says group H1 result due Sept 13.

text.p: Zagrebacka Banka d.d., leading Croatian commercial bank, said on Wednesday its unaudited fully consolidated half-year results would be released on Friday, September 13.

Unconsolidated figures for the bank only, issued this week in compliance with Zagreb Stock Exchange regulations, showed preliminary January-June pre-tax profit at 108 million kuna, compared to a loss in the same period of 1995.
As a result, Zagrebacka Banka ordinary shares closed up at 740 kuna on Zagreb's bourse on Tuesday after firming 10 kuna.
Its GDRs, representing 1/10 of each share, traded on Wednesday at $14.87/$15.25 on Seaq International in London.
The bank had posted a net profit of 124.3 million kuna in 1995, while making some 184 million loss on the group level. -- Kolumbina Bencevic, Zagreb Nmewsroom, 385-1-4557075
